svg.text: Click a cell in a computation: the cells connected to it light up by role, all other cells are dimmed. No arrows.
Group: every cell connected to this one, however
Chain: only what feeds this cell and what it feeds
Marker on sheet tabs when the connection continues there
Other cells are always dimmed while following.
Dimmed text keeps a contrast of at least 4.5 : 1.
Esc clears · Ctrl+Alt+F switches following on/off
